name: Shahzad Hasan
description:
'''Syed Shahzad Hasan''' better known as '''Shahi Hasan''', is a Pakistani musician, [[record producer]], [[Actor|occasional actor]], [[bass guitar]]ist, [[backing vocalist]] and music industry executive. Co-founding the [[Pakistani pop music|pop]] and [[Pakistani rock|rock]] band, [[Vital Signs (band)|Vital Signs]], with [[Electronic keyboard|keyboardist]] [[Rohail Hyatt]] in 1986, he earned recognition as a bass guitarist and an founding member of Vital Signs.

In addition to his role as the band's [[Bass guitar|bass player]] and [[backing vocalist]], he has undertaken many other roles for the band, such as [[Music producer|producing]] and [[Music producer|co-producing]] their [[Vital Signs discography|albums]], producing backstage music for the popular television series, ''[[Coke Studio Pakistan (season 5)|Coke Studio]]''. In Pakistan, he has been cited as one of the greatest bassist in the country as well as earned much respect in the country for producing the music. 

In 2003, he composed the song ''Mann ki Lagan'' for the movie ''[[Paap]]'', with lyrics penned by [[Amjad Islam Amjad]]. The track, which launched the [[Hindi cinema|Bollywood]] career of [[Rahat Fateh Ali Khan]], was based on an original composition by [[Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan]].

In 2013, he recently came in the limelight after collaborating with various musicians to compose the ''Naya Pakistan'' and currently hosting the music competitive show, ''Cornetto Youth Icon'' on [[MTV Pakistan]].

In April 2013, Hasan joined [[Meesha Shafi]], [[Strings (band)|String]], [[Ali Azmat]] and [[Alamgir (pop singer)|Alamgir]] as a judge on the immensely popular singing talent show ''[[Cornetto Music Icons]]'' aired on [[ARY Digital]].

Recently in 2017, he appeared as one of the judges in Pepsi Battle of the Bands season 2, he was the only judge retained from the earlier ''BoB'' edition back in 2002.
